title: VTA PCS — Trustee Read — payload
description: A trustee's client asks its VTA for a voting/trustees/status or voting/election/show request signed as the trustee, so it can follow the election's ceremony at the ballot box — on a private board as on a public one — without holding the trustee's key.

contextId.description: The VTA context the trustee's keys live in.

community.description: The community's DID: the registrar that registered the election.

trustee.description: The trustee's DID: a persona this VTA holds an authentication key of.

ballotBox.description: The ballot box's DID: the recipient of the signed request.

read.description: Which read to sign: voting/trustees/status/0.1 or voting/election/show/0.2.

ReadDocument.title: ReadDocument
ReadDocument.description: A complete, signed voting/trustees/status/0.1 or voting/election/show/0.2 request document, ready to send to the ballot box unchanged.

payload.description: `{ community, electionId }` from the request, exactly.

proof.description: A Data Integrity proof by an `authentication` key of `issuer`.

Response.title: VTA PCS — Trustee Read — response payload
Response.description: The signed read, to send to the ballot box.
